XData.Data:
<transform sourceClass='EnsLib.HL7.Message' targetClass='EnsLib.HL7.Message' sourceDocType='SchedCern:Sched_Cern' targetDocType='SchedCern:Sched_Cern' create='new' language='objectscript' > <annotation>Map UofU Sched Hl7 to Cerner Hl7</annotation> <assign value='source' property='target' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{PIDgrp(1).PV1:AlternateVisitID.IDNumber}' property='target.{SCH:FillerAppointmentID.entityidentifier}' action='set' /> <assign value='context.pid15' property='target.{PID:PrimaryLanguage.Identifier}' action='set' />
<foreach property='source.{PIDgrp(1).PID:PhoneNumberHome()}' key='k1' > <if condition='(source.{PIDgrp(1).PID:PhoneNumberHome(k1).TelecommunicationEquipmentTy} = "PH")' > <true> <assign value='"193"' property='target.{PIDgrp(1).PID:PhoneNumberHome(k1).TelecommunicationUseCode}' action='set' /> </true> </if> <if condition='(source.{PIDgrp(1).PID:PhoneNumberHome(k1).TelecommunicationEquipmentTy} = "CP")' > <true> <assign value='"195"' property='target.{PIDgrp(1).PID:PhoneNumberHome(k1).TelecommunicationUseCode}' action='set' /> </true> </if> <if condition='(source.{PIDgrp(1).PID:PhoneNumberHome(k1).TelecommunicationUseCode} = "NET")' > <true> <assign value='"50450664"' property='target.{PIDgrp(1).PID:PhoneNumberHome(k1).TelecommunicationUseCode}' action='set' /> </true> </if> <assign value='""' property='target.{PIDgrp(1).PID:PhoneNumberHome(k1).TelecommunicationEquipmentTy}' action='set' /> </foreach>
<foreach property='source.{PIDgrp(1).PID:PhoneNumberBusiness()}' key='k1' > <if condition='(source.{PIDgrp(1).PID:PhoneNumberBusiness(k1).TelecommunicationEquipmentTy} = "WK")' > <true> <assign value='"194"' property='target.{PIDgrp(1).PID:PhoneNumberBusiness(k1).TelecommunicationUseCode}' action='set' /> </true> </if> <if condition='(source.{PIDgrp(1).PID:PhoneNumberBusiness(k1).TelecommunicationEquipmentTy} = "CP")' > <true> <assign value='"195"' property='target.{PIDgrp(1).PID:PhoneNumberBusiness(k1).TelecommunicationUseCode}' action='set' /> </true> </if> <if condition='(source.{PIDgrp(1).PID:PhoneNumberBusiness(k1).TelecommunicationUseCode} = "NET")' > <true> <assign value='"50450665"' property='target.{PIDgrp(1).PID:PhoneNumberBusiness(k1).TelecommunicationUseCode}' action='set' /> </true> </if> <assign value='""' property='target.{PIDgrp(1).PID:PhoneNumberBusiness(k1).TelecommunicationEquipmentTy}' action='set' /> </foreach>
</transform>
